subject: citrus-winged moth
requested_medium: citrus rind, velvet, and glass material fantasy
art_direction: 飞蛾翅膀像两片厚柑橘果皮，透明果肉窗与深绿绒体，正面像展开的披风。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Invent a moth with broad wings made from thick orange citrus rind, each containing one translucent pulp-like window. Its small central body is dark-green velvet, with short rounded antennae and a quiet curious face. Spread the wings frontally, one slightly lower, keeping the outline compact like an open cloak. Show pores in the rind, fibrous membrane edges, and a few soft hairs on the body without becoming anatomical. Use a pale sage background and gentle backlight through the wing windows, avoiding glitter, flower scenes, and realistic insect distress. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
